title: Asthma and Primary Arterial Hypertension: an Inflammatory Link?
official: Asthma and Primary Arterial Hypertension: an Inflammatory Link?
summary: A low-intervention, prospective, experimental study will be conducted with the overall aim of assessing the inflammatory, functional and clinical differences between patients with asthma and those with asthma and hypertension, in order to improve our understanding of asthma and its comorbidities
